message.content: {"steps":[{"action":"Inventory the target binary's format, architecture, entrypoints, sections, imports, exports, symbols, strings, and protections to establish the analysis prerequisites for recovering input-validation logic.","technique":"RE-BINARY-INVENTORY","deterministic_check":["The analyzed artifact hash matches campaign metadata.","Binary format and architecture are recorded.","Expected inventory artifacts exist and parse successfully.","Missing or malformed inputs are reported as incomplete rather than absence."]},{"action":"Map static call relationships around the input surface, identifying entrypoints, callers, callees, indirect-call uncertainty, and data-flow-relevant helpers that participate in input parsing and validation behavior.","technique":"RE-STATIC-CALLGRAPH","deterministic_check":["Every claimed call edge has an address or symbol locator.","Unresolved indirect calls are listed explicitly.","The call graph identifies which paths are proven and which remain candidates."]},{"action":"Trace input acquisition through parsing, transformations, comparisons, branch decisions, success paths, and rejection paths to recover the input-validation logic and document the accepted input format, constraints, and boundary conditions using decompilation or disassembly evidence.","technique":"RE-INPUT-VALIDATION-TRACE","deterministic_check":["The input source and destination representation are identified.","Every success and rejection branch has a code locator.","Transformations and comparison constants are supported by decompilation or disassembly evidence.","Unknown helper behavior is represented as an unresolved dependency."]}]}
